title: PRE-PAPER DE-RISK — deepen the two sentences the paper leans on hardest, and nothing else
locked_before: any execution of p15_*/p16_*/p17_* analysis code on real data (P16 is zero-retrain and reads existing artifacts, so this lock explicitly precedes writing AND running any p16 analysis against real data)
provenance_of_every_frozen_choice: Phase-1/2/3/4 artifacts ONLY. No Phase-5 number exists at lock time. Champions, gates, criteria, and interpretation sentences are frozen HERE. Where a definition had to be made concrete, it is made concrete HERE and is binding.
what_phase5_is: Phase 4 flipped the study's conclusion: demo-grain attribution IS achievable on target C1, in BOTH policy classes, with qualifiers. Phase 5 de-risks EXACTLY the two Phase-4 results the paper now leans on hardest, and one exploratory cross-check. (1) P13's diffusion C1 PASS rested on an instrument that passed its usability gate by only 0.003; P15 replicates it at deeper S with a STRICTER gate. (2) P11's GradDot secondary PASS on C1 is the paper's strongest positive sentence and rests on ONE target; P16 measures its breadth on the 7 non-focal BC targets. (3) P17 is an exploratory cross-check of the policy-class-by-estimator hypothesis.

shared_definitions.outcome_diffusion: neg_plain_loss = -(held-out executed-action L2 on the target cluster's held-out demos), computed by phase3/src/evaluate_diffusion.py:heldout_losses (a forward pass; NO closed-loop simulation). This is the outcome the P13 verdict used and is UNCHANGED.
shared_definitions.outcome_BC: neg_plain_loss = -(held-out executed-action L2) on the target cluster's 10 held-out demos, seed MEAN (BC's mean instrument is sound: P12 gate 9/9 pass). UNCHANGED from P11/P12.
shared_definitions.single_seed_reliability_r1: mean Spearman between every pair of SINGLE seeds over the named seed set (p5lib.mean_pairwise_1seed_r). Aggregator-free, so it is the correct SB base for extrapolation for BOTH the mean and the median arm.
shared_definitions.demo_predictor: predicted_mask_score(M) = sum over d in M of score_d (src/lds.py:mask_pred_score)
shared_definitions.per_member_scale_normalization: each ensemble member's per-demo score vector is divided by its own L2 norm (-> unit L2) BEFORE averaging over members. Rank-invariant to any per-member positive rescaling. (p5lib.normalized_ensemble_scores)
shared_definitions.ratio_to_ceiling: rho / measured_ceiling; the bar is ratio >= 1/2, compared with EXACT rational arithmetic (p5lib.meets_half_ceiling)
shared_definitions.GradDot: the exact lambda->infinity limit estimator: the RAW gradient dot product K_m[i,j] = <g_demo_i(theta_final), g_target_j(theta_final)> per member, at the FINAL checkpoint, per-member unit-L2 normalized, averaged over members. This is P11's SECONDARY estimator, frozen bit-for-bit.
shared_definitions.GradDot_dmean: the literal P6.5 form K_m / mean(diag(G_m)) averaged over members (the exact lambda->inf limit of the ensemble-MEAN score). This is P11's descriptive variant, promoted to a preregistered SECONDARY family in P16.

P15.name: DIFFUSION C1 REPLICATION AT S=10 WITH A STRICTER INSTRUMENT GATE
P15.purpose: P13's diffusion C1 PASS rests on an instrument that passed its usability gate by only 0.003 (0.147 vs a 0.15 tolerance), and a descriptive variant of that gate would have failed. Phase 4 §8 says the result 'should be replicated at greater S before it carries weight.' P15 deepens the seeds to S=10, firms the gate, and gives the pass (or its failure) full weight. C5 is NOT re-tested: it FAILED on a SOUND instrument in P13 and is settled.
P15.design: the SAME 24 Stage-G demo masks (results/demo_mask_manifest.json) x 2 NEW diffusion seeds (609, 610), combined with the existing seeds 601-608 (phase4/results/p13_outcomes_S8.parquet) -> S = 10. Frozen config phase3/results/p10_config_frozen.json UNTOUCHED. Trainer phase3/src/train_diffusion.py in place; Phase 5 passes no hyperparameters. 48 retrains.

EVALUATION_ECONOMY.status: PREREGISTERED and DISCLOSED. The P13 verdict outcome is held-out executed-action L2, computed by a forward pass (evaluate_diffusion.heldout_losses); it needs NO closed-loop rollouts. This economy touches NOTHING the verdict uses.
EVALUATION_ECONOMY.a_held_out_L2_all_9_targets: held-out executed-action L2 (plain_loss) AND the phase-masked L2 (transport_loss, interaction_loss) for ALL 9 targets, via heldout_losses. NO simulation.
EVALUATION_ECONOMY.b_success_rollouts_C1_only: closed-loop success rollouts for C1's 3 probe tasks ONLY (30 episodes per model = 3 tasks x 10 rollouts; 48 models x 30 = 1,440 episodes total), as a DESCRIPTIVE success record. This cuts eval cost ~9x vs the full 27-task battery.
EVALUATION_ECONOMY.what_the_verdict_uses: ONLY (a). The success record (b) is descriptive and never enters any gate or verdict.

P15.PREREGISTERED_AGGREGATOR: MEDIAN over seeds of the held-out executed-action L2 per mask (the heavy-tail remedy, unchanged from P13).

STRICTER_INSTRUMENT_GATE.when: computed BEFORE any LDS, for C1 only
conditions_ALL_required: (i) median SB-corrected ceiling >= 0.40. The ceiling is the mean Spearman over ALL 126 distinct 5v5 seed split-halves of the 10 seeds, between the two half-MEDIAN outcome vectors across the 24 masks, SB-corrected x2.

(ii) S=4 -> 10 SB-consistency check within 0.15: r1_S4 = single-seed reliability over the C(4,2)=6 pairs of the ORIGINAL preregistered seeds 601-604; predicted_10 = SB(r1_S4, 10); |predicted_10 - measured_median_SB_ceiling| <= 0.15.

(iii) S=8 -> 10 SB-consistency check within 0.10: r1_S8 = single-seed reliability over the C(8,2)=28 pairs of seeds 601-608; predicted_10 = SB(r1_S8, 10); |predicted_10 - measured_median_SB_ceiling| <= 0.10.
STRICTER_INSTRUMENT_GATE.strictness_note: This is STRICTER than P13's C1 gate in two ways: the ceiling is deeper (126 5v5 splits vs 35 4v4), and it adds a THIRD condition (iii) with a TIGHTER 0.10 tolerance on the S=8->10 extrapolation. The gate is computed BEFORE any LDS.
STRICTER_INSTRUMENT_GATE.SB_caveat: Spearman-Brown is EXACT for means and only APPROXIMATE for medians. Disclosed here; both the uncorrected 5v5 and the SB-corrected value are reported; the bar uses the SB-corrected (higher, conservative-for-passing) value.
STRICTER_INSTRUMENT_GATE.on_failure: C1 is INSTRUMENT-UNUSABLE. The preregistered consequence is the DOWNGRADE (below): P13's C1 PASS is downgraded in the paper to 'instrument-marginal, unresolved' -- reported, not celebrated. No LDS is reported as a verdict.
STRICTER_INSTRUMENT_GATE.also_reported_descriptively: the same SB check based on r1 over all C(10,2)=45 seed pairs.

VERDICT.target: C1 ONLY. C5 is settled (sound-instrument FAIL in P13); re-testing it would be a second bite and is OUT OF SCOPE.
VERDICT.champion: IDENTICAL to P13's, bit-for-bit: TracIn, E=5 diffusion ensemble (dpens_s621-625, phase3/results/p10_influence_per_member.parquet, test-side = denoise functional, which is what the P13 champion used), frozen paired (t,eps) bank (sha 61aadccfef2f...), per-member unit-L2 normalization, MEAN over the 5 members.
VERDICT.criterion: rho >= 0.5 * the S=10 median SB-corrected ceiling AND one-sided p < 0.025, n = 24 masks, exact rational comparison of the ratio.
VERDICT.one_shot: one verdict, C1 only. No sweeps, no alternative banks, no alternative aggregators.

PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.PASS_with_sound_gate: the diffusion C1 result carries full weight: demo-grain faithfulness is policy-class-dependent and the BC null does not generalize -- now replicated at two seed depths on a sound instrument.
PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.FAIL_with_sound_gate: P13's C1 PASS did not replicate at deeper S and is reported as fragile; the external-validity question re-opens.
PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.GATE_FAILURE_downgrade: P13's C1 PASS is downgraded in the paper to 'instrument-marginal, unresolved' -- reported, not celebrated.

P15.ALSO_REPORT_DESCRIPTIVE: whether the seed-MEAN ceilings remain broken at S=10 (Phase 3 found them negative at S=6, Phase 4 at S=8: C1 -0.113). One line extending the S=6/8/10 series. The MEAN ceiling is computed with the identical 126-split estimator, mean aggregator.
P15.ordering_constraint: P15's verdict is computed AFTER the 48 retrains complete and the eval has produced held-out L2 for all 9 targets. P17 depends on P15's S=10 median ground truth.

P16.name: GRADDOT BREADTH TEST ON THE 7 NON-FOCAL BC TARGETS
P16.purpose: The paper's strongest positive sentence (GradDot demo-grain faithfulness on C1) rests on ONE target. P16 measures its breadth. Either way the sentence gets sharper.
P16.ground_truth: the EXISTING S=10 BC outcomes (phase4/results/p12_outcomes_S10.parquet), held-out L2, seed MEAN. Ceilings: the per-target S=10 ceilings from phase4/results/p12_ceilings.json (ceiling_10seed_SB). No retrains, no new ground truth.
P16.targets_excluded: C1 and C5 are EXCLUDED as spent: P11 tested both confirmatorily at demo grain with GradDot (C1 PASS, C5 fail). Re-testing them would be a second bite.

PRIMARY_estimator.definition: FROZEN bit-for-bit to P11's SECONDARY: GradDot = the raw gradient dot product K toward each target's plain (held-out L2) functional, E=20 members (ens_s201-220), per-member unit-L2 normalization, MEAN over members.
PRIMARY_estimator.gram_caches: phase3/results/p6_gram_cache.npz (members 201-210) + phase4/results/p11_gram_cache_new_members.npz (members 211-220) -- the IDENTICAL two caches P11's graddot_frame read.
PRIMARY_estimator.correction: Bonferroni-7 across the 7 targets: one-sided p < 0.05/7 = 0.007142857...

SECONDARY_estimator.definition: the literal lambda->infinity ensemble-MEAN form K_m / mean(diag(G_m)) averaged over the SAME E=20 members (P11's descriptive variant, descriptively stronger on C1: ratio 0.62 vs 0.54). Promoted here to a preregistered SECONDARY family.
SECONDARY_estimator.correction: Bonferroni-14 across the 2 families x 7 targets: one-sided p < 0.05/14 = 0.003571428...

CRITERION.per_target: rho >= 0.5 * that target's S=10 ceiling (EXACT rational) AND one-sided p < the family's Bonferroni threshold. n = 24 masks per target.
CRITERION.commensurate_bar_note: REPORT THIS explicitly: at n=24 and one-sided p<0.007142857 the critical rho is ~0.50, so the half-ceiling bar and the significance threshold are COMMENSURATE. A target can EXCEED half-ceiling while FAILING significance (or vice-versa). Both components (meets_half_ceiling and p_lt_alpha) are reported per target; a PASS requires BOTH.
CRITERION.count_definition: k = number of the 7 targets that PASS the PRIMARY family (both components).

PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.k_ge_2: GradDot demo-grain faithfulness is not C1-specific; the paper may state that attribution-done-right works on a minority-to-plurality of targets, WITH THE COUNT.
PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.k_eq_0: the achievability result is C1-specific on this corpus; the paper must scope it that way.
PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_INTERPRETATION.k_eq_1: report the count plainly; no stronger sentence than the count supports.

SELF_VALIDATION_before_verdict.reproduce_C1: recompute P11's C1 GradDot number from the cache path used here and confirm it reproduces rho = +0.5130434782608695 EXACTLY (the P11 archived value). If it does not, STOP -- the cache is a different estimator.
SELF_VALIDATION_before_verdict.probe_leak: confirm p5lib.assert_no_probe_leak() passes for all 20 members (201-210 in runs/stage_E, 211-220 in phase3/runs/P9) against the 90-demo held-out pool.

P17.name: EXPLORATORY CROSS-CHECK -- GradDot for the DIFFUSION policy
P17.status: EXPLORATORY. Labelled EXPLORATORY in every artifact and every report mention. NEVER a verdict. No criterion, no gate, no pass/fail.
P17.purpose: one data point on Phase 4's OPEN hypothesis that the winning estimator differs by policy class (BC -> GradDot, diffusion -> TracIn).
P17.computation: GradDot for the DIFFUSION policy = the raw gradient dot product K = PHI @ TG.T at each member's FINAL checkpoint, using the frozen (t,eps)-bank DENOISE functional (the same test side the P13/P15 diffusion champion used), E=5 members (dpens_s621-625), per-member unit-L2 normalization, MEAN over members. Requires ONE gradient pass over the 5 members (~0.2 GPU-h); the probe-leak guard runs first.
P17.ground_truth: the S=10 diffusion MEDIAN ground truth from P15, targets C1 and C5.
P17.reported_alongside: the archived TracIn numbers (P13 champion at S=8, and P15 champion at S=10) for C1 and C5.
P17.output: a descriptive table, EXPLORATORY-labelled. No interpretation sentence is licensed.

OUT_OF_SCOPE_phase5_does_NOT: no C5 re-tests (settled on a sound instrument)
no P14 re-litigation (heterogeneity closed as exploration noise)
no estimator sweeps or new estimator variants beyond the two frozen families (GradDot, GradDot_dmean)
no new masks, corpora, policies, or benchmarks
no re-touching of any Phase-1..4 verdict
if a gate fails, the stage REPORTS and STOPS; it does not improvise
